author: sonnet
label: climb-03-01
changes: Added a Terms section and a short opening summary, per the layout step.
Defined state, nonce, PKCE verifier, ID token, sub, attempt, pending link and pid in one line each.
Removed started_at from the attempt JSON, the C1 check and the failure table, since the Redis TTL already enforces the 10 minutes.
Clarified in the flowchart that state comes from the callback query string and the server makes the token call.
Added the redirect to GET /auth/google/confirm and the pid creation to the pending-link node.
Added why the password confirm step exists and why link mode does not need it.
Added how Google-only users sign in, and how unlink and reset work for them.
Added a note that start_session replaces any existing session, and that login and confirm do not require being signed out.
Merged the separate state-rule bullets into one paragraph and folded the password-reset description into Background.
Reordered into newcomer layout: summary, Background, Terms, then the flowchart, then notes and tables.
Folded the 'Decisions this plan makes' list into one 'Endpoints and rules' section, with each rule stated once.
Merged 'Other notes' (changed email, unchanged flows, next, already signed in, not stored) into that same section and dropped the duplicated no-email and no-token mentions.
Merged the 'Verified status' and 'Changed Google email' notes into one 'No changes to users' rule, and merged 'Link mode needs no verified email' into it.
Cut the redundant 'Temporary state lives in Redis' decision, since the state table already says it.
Moved the cookie-compared-before-Redis note out of the failure table into the browser-binding rule.
Merged the 'Link mode signed out' failure row with the different-user case, and folded the race text under the state table with the failure-table race row.
Shortened Background and terms wording and removed the duplicate sentence that every sign-in ends in start_session.
Replaced the empty open-questions note with one line saying none are known.
